name: the Barrowlight
description: An iron lantern, plain and heavy, burning with a steady golden flame that gives off no smoke and no heat.

name: Tarnished Locket
description: A cheap tin locket gone black at the hinge. Inside is a lock of hair tied with grave-thread, and a name scratched so many times it has worn through the metal.

name: Scored Signet
description: An iron signet bearing the Ashen Order's flame, with a deep gouge cut across it: the mark a deserter makes so the ring can never seal an order again.

name: Elders' Writ
description: A folded writ under the wax of the elders of Hollin's Rest, naming you bailiff to the barrow's unsettled accounts. The ink has run in the rain, but the seal holds.

name: Bell Splinter
description: A curved sliver of green-black bronze that you found clenched in your own fist on the night the Barrowlight died. Hold it to your ear and you can almost hear the ringing.

name: Resonant Tuning-Tongue
description: The bronze clapper and tuning-tongue taken from Nocturne's central beacon by the Hollow Choir. Warm to the touch, it hums with a low, mournful pitch whenever held near the dead.

name: Smoked-Glass Beacon Lens
description: A curved pane of heavy ash-smoked crystal pried from Nocturne's central lantern by the Ashen patrol. Etched along its rim are the three marks of the Triad.

name: Ferryman's Obol
description: A flat lead token stamped with a three-arched bridge over black water. In the old days of the Under-Barrow, every traveler carried one to prove their passage was lawful.

name: Seal of the Waxing Moon
description: A heavy crescent disc of pale silver-bronze recovered from the Carillon of Lira. Warm to the touch, it hums with the quiet, resolving cadence of a finished lullaby.

name: Seal of the Unclouded Sun
description: A spoked disc of fire-gilded bronze unbolted from the Furnace of Remission. Cleaned of scorched lead, its rays catch the Barrowlight with a steady, unblinking warmth.
